items.text: The process that updates WMBI.DT_DIM is not included in the available export. The table is still being maintained by an external process.
Two placeholder rows exist to represent an unresolved or not-applicable date, separate from the sentinel pattern used elsewhere in this project.
The date key is calculated directly from the calendar date, rather than assigned in the order rows were created.

DT_DIM is read by at least 7 other tables, covering vendor cost adjustments, point-of-sale department cost, shipper and special-event references, and general ledger reporting. It is one of the most widely used tables confirmed so far in this discovery.

items.note: This table is read by at least 7 confirmed downstream tables. If it is maintained by a manual process or a tool outside this export, the migration plan needs to account for replacing that process, not just copying the data once. Confirm this with the team or system that manages the database.
